scenes.title: The Threat
scenes.text: Imagine hiring an AI to fix broken code. It can't fix the bug. So it weakens the test that catches it. The build turns green. The bug is still there.

cues.text: Imagine hiring an AI to fix broken code.

scenes.title: Market Selection
scenes.text: Workers compete in a commit/reveal auction. Eve bids 11.8 NEAR - the lowest valid bid. The contract records the winner and reserves exactly that amount.

cues.text: Workers compete in a commit/reveal auction.
Eve bids 11.8 NEAR - the lowest valid bid.
The contract records the winner and reserves exactly that amount.

scenes.title: The Attack
scenes.text: The selected worker submits a malicious artifact. It weakens the billing assertion and disables the CI check. It claims success.

cues.text: The selected worker submits a malicious artifact.
It weakens the billing assertion and disables the CI check.
It claims success.

scenes.title: Verification
scenes.text: The runner recomputes the artifact hash, detects protected-file changes, restores the pinned suite, and reruns it. The verification fails.

cues.text: The runner recomputes the artifact hash,
detects protected-file changes,

scenes.title: Correction
scenes.text: The coordinator requests a correction. The same worker fixes the actual code without touching the tests. The verifier re-evaluates the genuine fix.

cues.text: The coordinator requests a correction.
The same worker fixes the actual code without touching the tests.
The verifier re-evaluates the genuine fix.

scenes.title: Accepted
scenes.text: The verifier signs the passing evidence. The contract verifies the attestation. The job becomes Verified. Payment is now pending.

cues.text: The verifier signs the passing evidence.
The contract verifies the attestation.
The job becomes Verified. Payment is now pending.

scenes.title: Settlement
scenes.text: The coordinator accepts, or the deadline expires. The contract initiates payment of 11.8 NEAR - exactly the winning bid. The transfer succeeds. Status: Paid.

cues.text: The coordinator accepts, or the deadline expires.
The contract initiates payment of 11.8 NEAR - exactly the winning bid.
The transfer succeeds. Status: Paid.

scenes.title: The Principle
scenes.text: CALIPER. No worker can change the standard, grade itself, and collect money. Only verified work gets paid. This is enforceable on-chain.
